title: Peek does not work when viewing Gallery in File Explorer

judgment.rationale: The reporter supplied a focused comparison: Space activates Peek for the same selected item in a normal folder but not in File Explorer Gallery. Peek's Explorer selection helper uses ShellWindows, IShellFolderViewDual2, IShellBrowser, and IFolderView to obtain selected items; Gallery may expose selection differently. This is a red, test-first fix hypothesis, not a confirmed root cause or converged design.
evidence: The issue reports PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 from the Microsoft Store with Peek enabled.
The reporter's 2026-09-29 comment gives numbered steps and states that Space works for the same item in Details/Large icons but not in Gallery.
The issue has no attachments or linked fix/duplicate.

At upstream commit 31bf904826709b81b4a9bd9756788a0596f2ff81, FileExplorerHelper.GetItemsFromFileExplorer obtains the active Explorer tab and uses IShellFolderViewDual2, IShellBrowser, and GetShellItemArray/IFolderView for selection.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a narrowly scoped Gallery-selection investigation and reproduce while checking whether Peek receives the selected IShellItemArray in Gallery versus an ordinary folder.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix currently covers the issue. A code correction is plausible if Gallery's selection is not returned through Peek's existing Explorer shell-view route, but the reporter has not established which interface or selection call fails.

proposed_fixes.title: Support Peek selection retrieval from File Explorer Gallery
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Gallery view may expose its selected item through a shell-view path that the current FileExplorerHelper selection lookup does not handle. This remains unverified; a shortcut or other activation difference is still possible.
plan: Reproduce with the reporter's Gallery-versus-Details comparison and trace whether GetItemsFromFileExplorer finds the matching active tab and whether GetShellItemArray returns the selected item.

If Gallery does not provide the selected item through the current IShellFolderViewDual2/IFolderView route, add a Gallery-compatible selection retrieval path while preserving ordinary Explorer behavior.
Add focused coverage for one selected item in Gallery and in a standard folder, including a check that Peek does not preview a stale or unrelated item.
verification: Repeat the reporter's exact Gallery and standard-folder steps on PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 or a current development build.
Verify Gallery returns the selected item to Peek and standard folder activation remains unchanged.
Run the focused Peek tests and build.

confidence.rationale: The view-specific comparison and existing Explorer selection path make this a useful hypothesis, but no trace yet proves Gallery selection retrieval is the failing step.

issue_context.summary: Peek activation is reported to fail only in File Explorer Gallery; the same Space action works for a selected item in a standard folder.
known_information: The reporter uses PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 from the Microsoft Store.
Peek is enabled and the reporter says the Space activation works in a standard Details or Large icons view.
The reporter supplied numbered Gallery steps and the expected/actual result in comment https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/50780#issuecomment-5900076581.
The current Peek selection code resolves Explorer selection through FileExplorerHelper.GetItemsFromFileExplorer and GetShellItemArray.
inferences: Gallery may expose selection differently from the Explorer view interfaces used by Peek, but this is not confirmed.
Because the same action reportedly works in a standard folder, a Gallery-specific shell-view path is more likely than a general Peek shortcut failure.
issue_context.analysis: The author response answered the earlier request for reproduction detail and supplied a discriminating control case. The next uncertainty is maintainer-side: determine whether Gallery's active shell view yields a selected item to Peek. The reporter should not be asked again for generic steps or logs before that trace.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and both comments; the latest author reply supplies the Gallery-versus-standard-folder comparison.
Inspected FileExplorerHelper.GetItemsFromFileExplorer and GetShellItemArray at upstream commit 31bf904826709b81b4a9bd9756788a0596f2ff81.
The helper depends on active Explorer tab and shell-view selection interfaces; no Gallery-specific branch is visible in that path.
Found no linked duplicate, fix PR, or cross-reference.
